payload.text: The install of a build of main on hv's Mac, in place of 0.4.6 build 1494, the dev build hv looked at (hv's choice: main until the 2.14.2 cut installs the release asset). It runs as runs/run-main-install.sh <main's sha>. Released when 0102 has landed (vc's point 4, 22 Oct), so the one install carries 0072 and 0102, and vc names intent-vc's gap and GOes its START. If 2.14.2's cut comes first, the cut's install of the release asset replaces it (decision 52).
